facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - thermal exposure at P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-4102 and PT-4102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during routine operation while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 16 January 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on P-4102 and PT-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
